verdict.rationale: Gitleaks' own README documents running it as a pre-commit hook by copying the example `pre-commit.py` script into `.git/hooks/`. It also shows sample output where a commit containing a secret fails the 'Detect hardcoded secrets' check, so secrets are blocked before they enter history. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of hook behavior, and deeper first-party docs on hook setup and configuration (e.g. pre-commit framework config, staged-only scanning details).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the scanner as a pre-commit hook so secrets and issues never enter my git history

citations.quote: You can run Gitleaks as a pre-commit hook by copying the example `pre-commit.py` script into your `.git/hooks/` directory.
